evals.prompt:
Bir atıştırmalık bar reçetem var, besin etiketi hesapla:
- Antep fıstığı: %40
- Hindistan cevizi unu: %20
- Hurma (kuru): %25
- Kakao tozu (şekersiz): %10
- Hindistan cevizi yağı: %5
evals.expected_output: 7-section Turkish nutrition label with BESIN DEĞERLERİ header, 100g values for all 9 nutrients, matching table with USDA sources, energy check, and disclaimer. No serving size section since none was specified.

assertions.name: contains_besin_degerleri_header
assertions.description: Output contains 'BESIN' in the label section (Turkish header)

assertions.name: contains_100g_label
assertions.description: Output contains '100 g' reference (standard per-100g labeling)

assertions.name: contains_kj_and_kcal
assertions.description: Energy shown in both kJ and kcal

assertions.name: contains_all_9_nutrients
assertions.description: All 9 mandatory nutrients present: enerji, yağ, doymuş yağ, karbonhidrat, şeker, lif, protein, tuz

assertions.name: contains_matching_table
assertions.description: Output includes USDA ingredient matching table with FDC IDs

assertions.name: no_serving_size_section
assertions.description: Since no serving size was given, output should NOT contain a per-serving column or section

assertions.name: contains_disclaimer
assertions.description: Output contains the mandatory disclaimer about laboratory analysis requirement

evals.prompt:
Antep fıstıklı bar besin değerlerini hesapla. Porsiyon: 35g

Reçete:
- Antep fıstığı: %40
- Hindistan cevizi unu: %20
- Hurma: %25
- Kakao tozu: %10
- Hindistan cevizi yağı: %5
evals.expected_output: 7-section output including both 100g and 35g serving columns. Kakao must match 'cocoa powder unsweetened' not a beverage mix.

assertions.name: contains_besin_degerleri_header
assertions.description: Output contains 'BESIN' in the label section

assertions.name: contains_100g_label
assertions.description: Output contains '100 g' reference

assertions.name: contains_serving_size_35g
assertions.description: Output contains '35 g' serving size values

assertions.name: contains_kj_and_kcal
assertions.description: Energy shown in both kJ and kcal

assertions.name: contains_all_9_nutrients
assertions.description: All 9 mandatory nutrients present

assertions.name: contains_matching_table
assertions.description: Output includes USDA ingredient matching table

assertions.name: cocoa_correct_match
assertions.description: Kakao matched to 'cocoa powder unsweetened' or 'cocoa dry powder' — NOT a beverage mix

assertions.name: contains_disclaimer
assertions.description: Output contains mandatory disclaimer

evals.prompt:
Aşağıdaki reçetenin besin değerlerini hesapla. Porsiyon: 25g

Malzemeler (gram cinsinden):
- Badem: 50g
- Fındık: 30g
- Kakao tozu: 15g
- Tuz: 5g
evals.expected_output: Gram→percentage conversion (50%/30%/15%/5%), then full 7-section output with both 100g and 25g serving.

assertions.name: contains_besin_degerleri_header
assertions.description: Output contains 'BESIN' in the label section

assertions.name: shows_gram_to_percent_conversion
assertions.description: Output shows gram-to-percentage conversion: 50g→50%, 30g→30%, 15g→15%, 5g→5%

assertions.name: contains_100g_label
assertions.description: Output contains '100 g' reference

assertions.name: contains_serving_size_25g
assertions.description: Output contains '25 g' serving size

assertions.name: contains_kj_and_kcal
assertions.description: Energy shown in both kJ and kcal

assertions.name: contains_all_9_nutrients
assertions.description: All 9 mandatory nutrients present

assertions.name: contains_disclaimer
assertions.description: Output contains mandatory disclaimer
